card.name: Partway through milli- and mummy words
card.fires_on: The second piece of a split word after "mill" (igram, igrams) in dose units, and similar middle pieces like "umm", "mmm" and "em" inside rarer words.

modes.label: Milligram after mill
modes.description: The ending of "milligram(s)" once "mill" has been read, in dose statements.

modes.label: Milligram-per-milligram
modes.description: The final "igram" in the phrase about products not being substitutable on a milligram basis.
modes.example: Tablets and oral suspension are not bioequivalent and are therefore not substitutable on a milligram-per-mill<<igram>> basis.

modes.label: Odd mid-word pieces in web text
modes.description: Middle pieces of split general words such as mummified, hmmm, immemorial.
modes.example: they were m<<umm>>ified, and placed in a special cemetery

card.plain: It fires in the middle of the word milligram, and in a few other oddly split words like mummified.
